text: Final inference: canonical Transport has a positive true-minus-nonmatch margin (0.04881, crossed 95% CI 0.02331 to 0.07298), but other-participant same-item templates are also positive (0.03572, 0.01074 to 0.05986), newtest group templates are positive (0.04085, 0.00915 to 0.07040), and own-minus-group is null (0.01309, -0.01438 to 0.03781). Neither group evidence nor own evidence beyond group improves held-out old/lure newness prediction. Interpretation: weak image-identity signal, no demonstrated participant-specific reinstatement. Exact masks remain the principal deferred discriminator.
